title: Connecting Bluetooth Devices
drDigitalIntro:
Bluetooth lets your computer talk to things nearby without a wire — headphones, a keyboard, a mouse, a speaker.
• To connect one: open Settings, go to Bluetooth, and click Connect next to the name of the device. It has to be switched on and close by, within about ten metres.
• Once it works, the list says Connected. Your computer remembers it, so next time it connects on its own.
• To disconnect — say you want to use the same headphones with your phone — click Disconnect. The name stays in the list, so connecting again is one click.
• If it will not connect: turn Bluetooth off and on again, or switch the device off and on. That fixes it most of the time.
• One thing at a time is the usual rule. Headphones connected to your computer may refuse to play sound from your phone until you disconnect them here.

playgroundTask.goal: Connect your wireless headphones and then disconnect them

steps.say: Open the Bluetooth section in Settings.
Click Connect next to Wireless Headphones.
Now click Disconnect to unpair the headphones.

drDigitalSuccess: You connected and disconnected a Bluetooth device! Now you know how to pair wireless accessories with your computer.
drDigitalHint: Open Settings on the left, click Bluetooth, then use the Connect and Disconnect buttons next to Wireless Headphones.
